feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 October 2026 4:14pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 30 October 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind in the North Channel at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over northern Germany, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the North Channel at first, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight, then veering south or southwest tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight overnight.


##Weather##

Fair, risk of fog patches in the east at first tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, veering north or northwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in places later.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain for a time overnight, becoming fair again early on Sunday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any rain.
